name: lineagepilot
description: Lineage and change impact for your project's models, exposures and Airflow tasks, from the artifacts already in your workspace. No server, no account.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode LineagePilot only reads the project's artifacts: it never runs dbt, never runs an interpreter from inside the workspace, and uses only its built-in rules.

lineagePilot.python.interpreterPath.markdownDescription: Python 3.10+ interpreter for the LineagePilot language server. Machine-scoped, so workspace settings cannot set it. When empty, the Python extension's active interpreter is used, then `python3` on `PATH` (`py -3` on Windows), then a Python managed by `uv`.

lineagePilot.dbt.executablePath.markdownDescription: The `dbt` executable that **Refresh dbt Artifacts** runs. Machine-scoped, so workspace settings cannot set it. When empty, `dbt` on `PATH` is used. dbt never runs in Restricted Mode.

lineagePilot.index.maxArtifactMB.markdownDescription: Larger `manifest.json` or `catalog.json` files are not indexed. Cannot be raised by an untrusted workspace.

lineagePilot.index.columnLineage.markdownDescription: Trace lineage column by column, from compiled SQL and `catalog.json`. The model-level graph is ready first; column lineage follows.

lineagePilot.baseline.manifestPath.markdownDescription: The manifest **Review Changes** compares columns with, typically the production one you use for dbt's `--state`. Absolute, or relative to the dbt project. When empty, columns are compared with `target/catalog.json`.

lineagePilot.airflow.dagFolders.markdownDescription: Folders, relative to the workspace folder, that hold Airflow DAG files. `**/dags` finds any folder called `dags`, up to six levels down. DAG files are only ever parsed, never imported or run.

lineagePilot.trace.server.description: Log the messages between VS Code and the LineagePilot language server.

viewsWelcome.contents: Open a model, source or properties file to see what is upstream and downstream of it.
The Airflow DAGs and tasks that run the open model appear here. Open a workspace with a dbt project and DAG files. DAG files are only ever parsed, never imported or run.

scripts.prepackage: python3 scripts/bundle_libs.py --clean-only && npm run typecheck && node esbuild.mjs --production
scripts.test:webview: node scripts/build_webview_tests.mjs && mocha --ui tdd --timeout 20000 --require out/webview-test/webview/test/setup.js --require out/webview-test/webview/test/cleanup.js "out/webview-test/webview/test/*.test.js"
scripts.test:webview-coverage: node scripts/build_webview_tests.mjs && c8 --all --src out/webview-test --include "out/webview-test/webview/src/**" --include out/webview-test/src/webviewMessages.js --include out/webview-test/src/reviewMessages.js --exclude out/webview-test/webview/src/main.js --exclude out/webview-test/webview/src/review/main.js --reporter text-summary --reporter json-summary --reporter html --report-dir coverage-webview mocha --ui tdd --timeout 20000 --require out/webview-test/webview/test/setup.js --require out/webview-test/webview/test/cleanup.js "out/webview-test/webview/test/*.test.js" && node scripts/check_coverage.mjs coverage-webview/coverage-summary.json 75
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && vscode-test
scripts.test:coverage: npm run compile-tests && node esbuild.mjs && node scripts/coverage_shim.mjs && vscode-test --label coverage --coverage --coverage-output coverage && node scripts/check_coverage.mjs coverage/coverage-summary.json 75
